items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Pearl Bailey only in the context of her relationship with Louie Bellson ('Louie was getting ready to go to London to meet Pearl to marry her') and her residence at Tizol's house. There is no direct interaction or personal connection described between the interviewee and Pea

ctx.x: A beautiful person. Everybody loved him, all over, you know. So he stayed with the band quite a while until he met Pearl -- Louie Bellson, he met Pearl. Tizol introduced them in Washington.
